Enclave is no ordinary SUV. Signature LED-accented headlamps and taillamps hint at the
powerful technology that awaits you within. Now enter its spacious, richly appointed
interior and let your eyes survey the refined details. The design sophistication of Enclave
reflects the level of comfort and control you’ll feel when you drive it.

TECHNOLOGY
WHEN THE ROAD IS CALLING
AND SO ARE
YOUR FRIENDS
Enclave understands you want to stay connected when you’re on the road. To keep your hands
on the wheel and eyes on the road, Buick IntelliLink1 lets you call up music, news, sports
and other features—using only simple voice commands. IntelliLink easily stores your mobile
phone contacts, and you can make hands-free calls. Bluetooth®2 connects your compatible
smartphone to Enclave’s high-resolution touch-screen. There’s even a text-to-speech feature
that takes the incoming texts to your phone and reads them back to you.

to find out which phones are compatible with the vehicle.

WH EN YOU ’RE TH E
MUSIC M AESTRO
Enclave helps you orchestrate your music, your way. Bluetooth pairs Enclave’s audio system with your compatible devices like
smartphones or MP3 players. (There’s also a USB port1 to directly connect your devices.) With simple voice commands or
steering-wheel-mounted controls, you can access available music apps on your smartphone such as Pandora® internet radio2
and SiriusXM Satellite Radio3 (3-month trial included). Best of all, you’ll hear your selections played through the available
Bose® 10-speaker sound system. So you’ll hear every note, maestro.

ALL-WHEEL DRIVE
WH EN POWER
M EE TS P O I S E
Enclave’s available All-Wheel Drive (AWD) constantly monitors traction at all four wheels. If it detects slip, power is delivered
to the wheel(s) with the best grip. In low-traction situations—like rain, sleet or snow—it can send up to 50 percent of engine
torque to either front wheel and up to 85 percent to either rear wheel. And on dry roads, performance and handling benefits
such as enhanced acceleration and torque reach all four wheels. Enclave’s power comes from a 3.6L V-6 with direct fuel
injection, variable valve timing, 288 hp and 270 lb-ft of torque. It’s paired with an electronically controlled 6-speed automatic
transmission that seamlessly shifts into the right gear for optimal performance and efficiency.

SEATING
CHOCCACHINO LEATHER-APPOINTED SEATING
The standard seven-passenger Enclave features three rows of premium seating. A pair of available leather-appointed captain’s
chairs in the second row is easy to access, thanks to rear doors that open wide. The third row is easily accessible, too, by
adults as well as children. Between the captain’s chairs, there’s a wide pass-through. And with the convenient Smart Slide feature,
moving the second-row seats gently forward is simple, so passengers of all ages can maneuver easily into the third row.

QUIETTUNING
WH EN CO NVERSATIO N
A N D Q U I E T I S A S C I E N C E
I S A N A RT
Close the doors of Enclave behind you and enter a hushed sanctuary that helps keep the noisy world outside at bay.
Buick engineered Enclave using QuietTuning, a technology that helps reduce, block and absorb noise and vibration in the
cabin, so it’s the ideal environment for good conversation. Prefer to enjoy music, instead? The available Bose 10-speaker
sound system was tuned to the acoustics of the Enclave interior. You’ll feel like you’re seated in a concert hall.
